reject missing duplicate ambiguous stale rounded-only or non-finite evidence

controls: Catalogue response must be bounded HTML from the official service, not a login/error/download body.
Bootstrap cookies and redirects must remain scoped to approved HMLR hosts with Secure/SameSite evidence.
Declared Content-Length, streamed byte count and final file size must agree when a length is supplied.
Content-Disposition filename must agree with the catalogue href and expected authority ZIP basename.
ZIP member timestamps must be receipted and must not imply a future or unrelated release.
Only supported non-encrypted ZIP compression methods may enter the GML extraction path.
XML declaration, BOM and decoded bytes must agree before Fiona/GML parsing.
Matcher timeout must terminate its full child process tree and remove partial match outputs.
Matcher Git blob and resolved Python executable must be pinned in the fresh-run receipt.
Match output must bind current run_id and retain identical SHA at production and consumption.
Official WCS calls must disable environment proxy inheritance and receipt direct HTTPS transport.
Every WCS redirect hop and final host must remain HTTPS on approved Environment Agency domains.
Capabilities root must advertise WCS service/version 2.0.1 exactly before CoverageId selection.
DescribeCoverage must contain exactly one matching CoverageDescription for the pinned CoverageId.
Grid envelope lower/upper corners must be finite, ordered and consistent with advertised axes.
Resolved GetCoverage query must preserve both subset parameters and the exact requested padded bounds.
Compressed transfer encoding must be bounded by decompressed byte count before GeoTIFF parsing.
Overview, alpha or auxiliary mask bands must not be mistaken for the single elevation band.
Valid 1m pixel count must be plausible against polygon area and documented nominal resolution.
Three target requests must not silently reuse one response; per-row URL, bounds and SHA must bind.
EA output must publish atomically and partial GeoTIFF/output bytes must be deleted on failure.
Business mode must pin the official OS Downloads API base and reject arbitrary override hosts.
OS product, download and archive requests must bypass environment proxies and receipt direct transport.
Bearer/API credentials must never be forwarded to a redirect host outside the approved OS authority.
Selected product record must bind OS Terrain 50, grid format and the current annual release metadata.
A GB-wide fallback may not silently replace an exact area download without an explicit provenance review.
Download URLs must reject duplicate or conflicting fileName/format/area query parameters.
Downloaded archive filename/content-disposition must agree with selected product, format and area.
Declared length, streamed bytes, final file size and SHA must agree before ZIP inspection.
URL-resolution-only --no-download success is diagnostic and cannot satisfy fresh-byte production gates.
Resolver and crosschecker subprocesses need bounded timeouts, progress receipts and process-tree cleanup.
Simultaneous archive/root configuration from CLI or environment must block instead of silently preferring one.
More than one sampled ASC for a required tile must block; duplicate files cannot weight the median twice.
RMSE tier screening must use raw finite medians/deltas before three-decimal presentation rounding.
human_review_required=true cannot coexist with automatic ready without a bound review receipt.
index.html must be a direct 200 UTF-8 HTML response from the selected loopback base.
Manifest must declare exact first/last operation numbers and they must equal 1 and the accepted total.
Non-object operation rows or rows missing required identity/status fields must block, not be filtered out.
Stored source URLs must be revalidated through bounded redirects and final publisher-authority mapping.
Multiple examples for one target must agree exactly or block; last-wins dictionary behaviour is forbidden.
ETag/Last-Modified or content hashes must prove index, manifest and members belong to one HTTP epoch.
Acceptance output must be atomic and bind current run_id, continuation and candidate SHA.
An explicitly configured valid base must not be bypassed by an unrelated fallback that happens to pass.
Candidate, HMLR, numeric and web outputs must live under one immutable run-scoped directory.
Every timed-out stage must terminate descendants and quarantine partial outputs before summary generation.
EA, metric, Terrain50 and web subprocesses require bounded timeouts and monotonic stage-heartbeat receipts.
Preacceptance and postacceptance candidate bytes must be separately hashed and their intended state transition verified.
A stage pending over 15 minutes must be marked blocked, preserve diagnostics and update the existing manual action.
